subject: I think CG should do it!!
author: ZombieTron
body:
If only to take a departure from Burnout for a while and then come back to Burnout 6 with another fresh perspective??

I still haven't played BLACK as much as I should have, we do have a copy now and I still intend to but, from what I have seen/played it is a little dark and difficult for me!! But, I would like to see CG make an online multiplayer FPS, just to see what they do with it.

As there has been talk of CG making an NFS game as well, it will be interesting to see what project they do next, and when this will start, and if we will hear about it from CG, or if they will keep it underwraps until it's due to be released??

I wonder if anyone at CG is working on a new game yet, or if they are all still busy beavering away at new Paradise stuff...

As the Paradise packs will keep going until Q2 this year, I wonder if we will hear about CG's next project until 2010!!

BLACK 2 has certainly been requsted by a lot of fans, and FPS's are historically better sellers then car games, so if they do BLACK 2 I'm sure it will be an amazing success for them.
